name: Relevance to Biomedical Context
description: Measures how well the summary captures key information relevant to the biomedical context and research questions posed in the original document.

name: Clarity and Coherence
description: Assesses the readability and logical flow of the summary, ensuring that it is understandable to a biomedical professional.

name: Conciseness
description: Evaluates the ability of the summary to convey necessary information without unnecessary detail or repetition.

name: Terminology Accuracy
description: Checks the correct usage of biomedical terms and concepts, reflecting an accurate understanding of the content.

name: Coverage of Key Findings
description: Assesses whether the summary covers all major findings and conclusions of the original document.

name: Fidelity to Original Intent
description: Ensures the summary maintains the intent and emphasis of the original document, without introducing bias or distortion.

name: Use of Citations and References
description: Evaluates how well the summary incorporates and attributes citations and references from the original document.
